en.t: 1 recipe pie crust (e.g. the pie dough from double-crust fruit pie, chapter 28)
1 tbsp (14 g) butter
1 small onion, finely chopped
1 small leek, finely chopped
225 g hanger steak, chopped
1 parsnip, finely chopped
1 potato, chopped
1 carrot, finely chopped
2 sprigs thyme, chopped
kosher salt and cracked black pepper
1 egg, beaten

sk.t: 1 dávka cesta na koláč (napr. cesto z ovocného koláča s dvojitým cestom, kapitola 28)
1 PL (14 g) maslo
1 malá cibuľa, nadrobno nasekaná
1 malý pór, nadrobno nasekaný
225 g hovädzia bránica (hanger steak), nasekaná
1 paštrnák, nadrobno nasekaný
1 zemiak, nakrájaný
1 mrkva, nadrobno nasekaná
tymián (2 vetvičky), nasekaný
hrubozrnná soľ a nahrubo drvené čierne korenie
1 vajce, rozšľahané

en.t: 1. Preheat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Melt butter in skillet and add onion and leek; cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool. In a bowl combine steak, parsnip, potato, carrot, and thyme, and toss to combine. Once onion and leeks are cool, add to mixture and mix. Season with salt and pepper.

2. Roll out pastry into 0.5 cm-thick sheet. Cut into 4 circles about 13 cm across. If all circles cannot be cut out of initial sheet of pastry re-roll pastry and cut out remaining circles if necessary.

3. Spoon between 80 and 120 ml of filling mixture onto one half of pastry circle. Brush edges with beaten egg and fold other half over filling. Seal by pressing gently with a fork or your fingers. Place on prepared baking sheet and repeat with remaining pastry and filling (there may be filling left over). Brush all pasties with beaten egg.
4. Place in 205 °C oven; when pastry begins to brown, turn oven down to 175 °C (fan 155 °C) and bake for an additional 25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool.

sk.t: 1. Rúru predhrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C). Na panvici rozpustíme maslo, pridáme cibuľu a pór a dusíme do mäkka, asi 5 minút. Odstavíme a necháme vychladnúť. V mise zmiešame hovädzie mäso, paštrnák, zemiak, mrkvu a tymian. Keď cibuľa a pór vychladnú, pridáme ich k zmesi a premiešame. Osolíme a okoreníme.
2. Cesto vyvaľkáme na plát hrubý 0,5 cm. Vykrojíme 4 kruhy s priemerom asi 13 cm. Ak sa z prvého plátu nedajú vykrojiť všetky kruhy, zvyšky cesta znova vyvaľkáme a vykrojíme zvyšné kruhy.

3. Na jednu polovicu každého kruhu dáme lyžicou 80–120 ml plnky. Okraje potrieme rozšľahaným vajcom a druhú polovicu preložíme cez plnku. Okraje spojíme jemným pritlačením vidličkou alebo prstami. Pirôžok preložíme na pripravený plech a postup zopakujeme so zvyšným cestom a plnkou (plnka môže zvýšiť). Všetky pirôžky potrieme rozšľahaným vajcom.
4. Vložíme do rúry vyhriatej na 205 °C; keď cesto začne hnednúť, znížime teplotu na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C) a pečieme ešte 25 minút. Vyberieme z rúry a necháme vychladnúť.

src: Serious Eats — Sohla El-Waylly — "Spanakopita (Greek Savory Greens Pie) Recipe"

en.v: Glass pie plate, rimmed baking sheet, pastry brush

sk.v: Sklenená forma na koláč, plech s okrajom, cukrársky štetec

c.t: Mix any quick-cooking greens (spinach, watercress, Swiss chard, arugula), avoiding hearty kale or collards; all spinach is traditional. Trahanas is a pasta of fermented dairy and grain that absorbs moisture from the greens; the same amount of rice, barley or couscous can replace it.

Kombinujte akúkoľvek rýchlo sa varicu zeleninu (špenát, žeruchu, mangold, rukolu), ale nie tuhý kel; tradičný je samotný špenát. Trahanas je cestovina z fermentovaného mlieka a obilia, ktorá nasaje vlhkosť zo zeleniny; nahradiť ju môže rovnaké množstvo ryže, jačmeňa alebo kuskusu.

en.t: 350 g chopped mixed greens and tender stems, gently packed, such as spinach, watercress, arugula, and Swiss chard
60 g chopped mixed tender herbs and tender stems, such as dill, parsley, chervil, and chives
50 g extra-virgin olive oil, plus more
1 1/2 tsp (6 g) kosher salt
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) freshly ground black pepper
3 sliced scallions, both white and green parts (about 60 g)
2 cloves (10 g) garlic, sliced
90 g trahanas; rice, barley, or couscous can substitute
1 large egg
226 g Greek feta, crumbled
6 sheets phyllo dough, thawed

1. Getting Started: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position. Preheat oven to 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Brush a 23 cm glass pie plate (either deep-dish or standard size will work with this recipe) generously with olive oil and set on a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet.
2. For the Filling: In a large bowl, combine chopped greens, chopped herbs, 59 ml olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Massage together to gently wilt the greens, then set aside.

3. In a small sauté pan over medium heat, add 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil, scallions, and garlic and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes. Add the hot mixture to the greens and combine to further wilt the vegetables. Add the trahanas (or your substitute of choice) and egg and thoroughly combine. Once everything is well mixed, fold in the crumbled feta.

4. To Assemble the Pie: Unroll thawed phyllo and keep it covered with a moist kitchen towel while working. Working with 1 sheet at a time, lay phyllo so that it is centered in the pie pan with the excess draping over the rim and brush generously with about 1 tbsp (15 ml) olive oil. Repeat with 3 more sheets of phyllo, each sheet placed perpendicular to the previous one, brushing with olive oil before adding the next.

5. Add greens mixture to phyllo-lined pie. Fold excess phyllo over greens and drape remaining 2 sheets of phyllo over the top. Drizzle with more olive oil. Slice into portions using a serrated knife. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Allow to cool at least 15 minutes before serving.
oil reduced to 60% ("50 g extra-virgin olive oil, plus more") — own adjustment
feta kept — feta is the defining cheese of spanakopita; this recipe is Low in lactose, not lactose-free —

1 veľké vajce
226 g grécka feta, rozdrobená

2. For the Filling: In a large bowl, combine chopped greens, chopped herbs, 35 ml olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Massage together to gently wilt the greens, then set aside.

3. In a small sauté pan over medium heat, add 1¾ tsp (9 ml) olive oil, scallions, and garlic and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes. Add the hot mixture to the greens and combine to further wilt the vegetables. Add the trahanas (or your substitute of choice) and egg and thoroughly combine. Once everything is well mixed, fold in the crumbled feta.

4. To Assemble the Pie: Unroll thawed phyllo and keep it covered with a moist kitchen towel while working. Working with 1 sheet at a time, lay phyllo so that it is centered in the pie pan with the excess draping over the rim and brush generously with about 1¾ tsp (9 ml) olive oil. Repeat with 3 more sheets of phyllo, each sheet placed perpendicular to the previous one, brushing with olive oil before adding the next.

5. Add greens mixture to phyllo-lined pie. Fold excess phyllo over greens and drape remaining 2 sheets of phyllo over the top. Drizzle with more olive oil. Slice into portions using a serrated knife. Bake in preheated oven until golden brown, about 45 minutes. Allow to cool at least 15 minutes before serving.

1. Príprava: Mriežku v rúre dáme do polohy pod stredom. Rúru predhrejeme na 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C). Sklenenú koláčovú formu s priemerom 23 cm (hlbokú aj klasickú) bohato potrieme olivovým olejom a postavíme na plech s okrajom vyložený papierom na pečenie.
2. Plnka: Vo veľkej mise zmiešame nasekanú listovú zeleninu, nasekané bylinky, 35 ml olivového oleja, soľ a čierne korenie. Rukami premasírujeme, aby zelenina mierne zvädla, a odložíme.

3. Na malej panvici na strednom ohni zohrejeme 1¾ ČL (9 ml) olivového oleja, pridáme jarnú cibuľku a cesnak a dusíme, kým nezmäknú, asi 5 minút. Horúcu zmes pridáme k zelenine a premiešame, aby ešte viac zvädla. Pridáme trahanas (alebo zvolenú náhradu) a vajce a dôkladne premiešame. Keď je všetko dobre spojené, vmiešame rozdrobenú fetu.

4. Skladanie koláča: Rozmrazené filo cesto rozvinieme a počas práce ho necháme prikryté vlhkou utierkou. Pracujeme vždy s 1 plátom: položíme ho do stredu formy tak, aby presahoval cez okraj, a bohato potrieme asi 1¾ ČL (9 ml) olivového oleja. Zopakujeme s ďalšími 3 plátmi, každý položíme kolmo na predchádzajúci a pred pridaním ďalšieho ho potrieme olejom.

5. Zeleninovú zmes dáme do formy vyloženej filom. Presahujúce filo preložíme cez plnku a navrch rozložíme zvyšné 2 pláty. Pokvapkáme ďalším olivovým olejom. Zúbkovaným nožom nakrájame na porcie. Pečieme vo vyhriatej rúre dozlatista, asi 45 minút. Pred podávaním necháme aspoň 15 minút vychladnúť.

origin.quote: For a twist on the classic, this version of traditional Greek spanakopita uses an assortment of greens and tender herbs in addition to spinach.

src: Serious Eats — Andrew Janjigian — "Borek (Armenian Spinach and Cheese Turnovers)"

en.v: The filling can be made up to 24 hours in advance and refrigerated. Stir well before using. Uncooked boreks freeze wonderfully. Just place them in an airtight container separated by sheets of waxed paper or parchment and freeze for up to 3 weeks. Bake directly from frozen, increasing the total bake time by 5 to 10 minutes. Leftover baked boreks can be reheated on a wire rack set inside a rimmed baking sheet,in a 200 °C (fan 180 °C) oven for 15 minutes.

sk.v: Plnku môžeme pripraviť až 24 hodín vopred a uchovávať v chladničke. Pred použitím ju dobre premiešame. Neupečené bureky sa výborne mrazia. Stačí ich uložiť do uzatvárateľnej nádoby, vrstvy oddeliť voskovaným papierom alebo papierom na pečenie a zmraziť až na 3 týždne. Pečieme ich priamo zmrazené a celkový čas pečenia predĺžime o 5 až 10 minút. Zvyšné upečené bureky ohrejeme na mriežke položenej na plechu s okrajom v rúre pri 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C) 15 minút.

c.t: 430 g tender fresh greens (spinach, watercress, arugula, Swiss chard, beet greens) can replace the frozen spinach: microwave them covered with 60 ml water until wilted, 3 to 5 minutes, rest covered 1 minute, cool, chop fine and squeeze dry; you need 200–225 g.

Use about 3 tbsp (40 g) filling per börek. Rewarm the butter as needed so it stays brushable. For 22 to 24 smaller böreks, cut the phyllo sheets lengthwise into thirds (27 strips of 33 × 15 cm) and use 2 scant tbsp filling each.

Mrazený špenát môžete nahradiť 430 g mladej čerstvej zeleniny (špenát, žerucha, rukola, mangold, cviklové listy): zakryté ju so 60 ml vody ohrejte v mikrovlnke, kým nezvädne, 3 až 5 minút, nechajte 1 minútu prikryté, vychladnúť, nadrobno nasekajte a vyžmýkajte; potrebujete 200–225 g.

Na jeden börek použite asi 3 PL (40 g) plnky. Maslo podľa potreby prihrievajte, aby sa dalo natierať. Na 22 až 24 menších börekov pokrájajte listy fylo pozdĺžne na tretiny (27 pásov 33 × 15 cm) a na každý použite 2 nevrchovaté PL plnky.

en.t: 225 g Greek feta, crumbled
115 g Muenster or Monterey Jack cheese, shredded
70 g fresh goat cheese, crumbled
60 g chopped mixed tender herbs and tender stems, such as dill, parsley, mint, and cilantro
4 scallions (60 g), thinly sliced
2 large eggs (110 g), lightly beaten
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) freshly ground black pepper
285 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed
225 g Greek feta, crumbled
70 g fresh goat cheese, crumbled
60 g chopped mixed tender herbs and tender stems, such as dill, parsley, mint, and cilantro
4 scallions (60 g), thinly sliced
2 large eggs (110 g), lightly beaten
1/4 tsp (0.8 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) freshly ground black pepper
9 (33 × 46 cm) sheets phyllo dough, thawed and rested at room temperature for 30 minutes
10 tbsp (140 g) unsalted butter
1 tbsp (15 ml) hulled sesame seeds
1 tsp (5 ml) nigella seeds (optional)
1. For the Herb and Cheese Filling: In a medium bowl, combine feta, Muenster, goat cheese, herbs, scallions, eggs, and pepper, and toss gently to combine. Cover and set aside.

2. For the Spinach, Herb, and Cheese Filling: Wrap spinach in a clean kitchen towel or double layer of paper towels and squeeze to remove excess moisture (you should end up with about 170 g spinach). Transfer to a medium bowl, along with feta, goat cheese, herbs, scallions, eggs, salt, and pepper, and toss gently to combine. Cover and set aside.

3. For the Boreks: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Using a sharp knife, cut stack of phyllo sheets in half to form eighteen 33 × 23 cm sheets. Stack together and cover with a sheet of parchment and a clean kitchen towel.

4. In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat and cook, swirling pan frequently and taking care not to let butter solids brown (lower heat as needed to medium-low if butter begins to pop and brown), until foaming subsides (an indication that water has been driven off), about 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat.

5. Remove one phyllo sheet from stack and transfer to clean work surface, with the long end of the sheet running parallel to edge of counter. Working lengthwise, brush half of phyllo sheet that is closest to you lightly but evenly with butter. Fold sheet in half toward you lengthwise, covering the buttered portion of dough. Rotate sheet 90° so short side now faces you, and brush entire surface of sheet lightly but evenly with butter.

6. Using a measure, place a scant 3 tbsp (40 g) filling on the bottom left-hand corner of sheet, about 2.5 cm from the bottom edge. Using a spoon, form filling into a rough triangle with its long edge (hypotenuse) facing the bottom right edge of the phyllo. Lift the bottom right corner of the phyllo and fold it over the filling and gently press to form a right triangle. Continue folding up and over, like folding a flag, until you reach the end of phyllo strip. Using a sharp knife, trim off any overhanging phyllo. Brush top of triangle with butter and transfer to a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, seam side down. Sprinkle with about 1/4 tsp (1.2 g) seed mixture.
7. Repeat borek-forming process with remaining phyllo and filling, arranging boreks in pairs with long edges facing each other, so that they form two rows of eight boreks.
8. Bake until golden and crisp, 20 to 23 minutes, rotating baking sheet halfway through baking. Transfer baking sheet to wire rack and let boreks cool at least 5 minutes before serving. Serve.
feta kept — feta is the main filling flavour; this recipe is Low in lactose, not lactose-free —
lactose-free mozzarella (light where melting is not essential) instead of fresh/soft cheese — own adjustment
lactose-free cream cheese instead of fresh goat cheese (minor creamy part of the filling; the feta carries the flavour) — own adjustment
lactose-free butter or ghee — own adjustment

sk.t: feta ponechaná — feta je hlavnou chuťou plnky; tento recept má nízky obsah laktózy, nie je bez laktózy —

c.t: 1. For the Herb and Cheese Filling: In a medium bowl, combine feta, Muenster, goat cheese, herbs, scallions, eggs, and pepper, and toss gently to combine. Cover and set aside.

2. For the Spinach, Herb, and Cheese Filling: Wrap spinach in a clean kitchen towel or double layer of paper towels and squeeze to remove excess moisture (you should end up with about 170 g spinach). Transfer to a medium bowl, along with feta, goat cheese, herbs, scallions, eggs, salt, and pepper, and toss gently to combine. Cover and set aside.

3. For the Boreks: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Using a sharp knife, cut stack of phyllo sheets in half to form eighteen 33 × 23 cm sheets. Stack together and cover with a sheet of parchment and a clean kitchen towel.

4. In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat and cook, swirling pan frequently and taking care not to let butter solids brown (lower heat as needed to medium-low if butter begins to pop and brown), until foaming subsides (an indication that water has been driven off), about 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from heat.

5. Remove one phyllo sheet from stack and transfer to clean work surface, with the long end of the sheet running parallel to edge of counter. Working lengthwise, brush half of phyllo sheet that is closest to you lightly but evenly with butter. Fold sheet in half toward you lengthwise, covering the buttered portion of dough. Rotate sheet 90° so short side now faces you, and brush entire surface of sheet lightly but evenly with butter.

6. Using a measure, place a scant 3 tbsp (40 g) filling on the bottom left-hand corner of sheet, about 2.5 cm from the bottom edge. Using a spoon, form filling into a rough triangle with its long edge (hypotenuse) facing the bottom right edge of the phyllo. Lift the bottom right corner of the phyllo and fold it over the filling and gently press to form a right triangle. Continue folding up and over, like folding a flag, until you reach the end of phyllo strip. Using a sharp knife, trim off any overhanging phyllo. Brush top of triangle with butter and transfer to a parchment-lined rimmed baking sheet, seam side down. Sprinkle with about 1/4 tsp (1.2 g) seed mixture.
7. Repeat borek-forming process with remaining phyllo and filling, arranging boreks in pairs with long edges facing each other, so that they form two rows of eight boreks.
8. Bake until golden and crisp, 20 to 23 minutes, rotating baking sheet halfway through baking. Transfer baking sheet to wire rack and let boreks cool at least 5 minutes before serving. Serve.
1. Bylinkovo-syrová plnka: V strednej mise jemne premiešame fetu, syr Muenster, kozí syr, bylinky, jarnú cibuľku, vajcia a korenie. Prikryjeme a odložíme.

2. Špenátovo-bylinkovo-syrová plnka: Špenát zabalíme do čistej kuchynskej utierky alebo dvojitej vrstvy papierových utierok a vytlačíme z neho prebytočnú vodu (malo by zostať asi 170 g špenátu). Preložíme do strednej misy, pridáme fetu, kozí syr, bylinky, jarnú cibuľku, vajcia, soľ a korenie a jemne premiešame. Prikryjeme a odložíme.

3. Böreky: Mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Ostrým nožom rozkrojíme stoh filo plátov na polovicu, aby vzniklo osemnásť plátov 33 × 23 cm. Uložíme ich na seba a prikryjeme papierom na pečenie a čistou kuchynskou utierkou.

4. V malom hrnci na strednom ohni rozpustíme maslo a varíme ho, často krúžime hrncom a dávame pozor, aby mliečne zložky nezhnedli (ak maslo začne prskať a hnednúť, znížime oheň na stredne nízky), kým neprestane peniť (znak, že sa odparila voda), asi 5–7 minút. Odstavíme.

5. Zo stohu vezmeme jeden plát fila a položíme ho na čistú pracovnú plochu dlhšou stranou rovnobežne s okrajom linky. Polovicu plátu bližšie k nám pozdĺžne zľahka, ale rovnomerne potrieme maslom. Plát pozdĺžne preložíme na polovicu k sebe, aby prekryl potretú časť. Plát otočíme o 90°, aby kratšia strana smerovala k nám, a celý povrch zľahka, ale rovnomerne potrieme maslom.

6. Odmerkou dáme slabé 3 PL (40 g) plnky do ľavého dolného rohu plátu, asi 2,5 cm od spodného okraja. Lyžicou z plnky vytvarujeme približný trojuholník, ktorého dlhá strana (prepona) smeruje k pravému dolnému okraju fila. Pravý dolný roh fila zdvihneme, preložíme cez plnku a jemne pritlačíme, aby vznikol pravouhlý trojuholník. Pokračujeme v prekladaní nahor a cez seba ako pri skladaní vlajky až po koniec pásu. Ostrým nožom odrežeme presahujúce filo. Vrch trojuholníka potrieme maslom a preložíme ho spojom nadol na plech s okrajom vyložený papierom na pečenie. Posypeme asi ¼ ČL (1,2 g) zmesi semienok.
7. Postup zopakujeme so zvyšným filom a plnkou; böreky ukladáme do dvojíc dlhšími stranami k sebe, aby vznikli dva rady po osem kusov.
8. Pečieme dozlatista a dochrumkava 20–23 minút, v polovici pečenia plech otočíme. Plech preložíme na mriežku a böreky necháme pred podávaním aspoň 5 minút chladnúť. Podávame.

en.t: 120 ml extra-virgin olive oil
1 onion, chopped fine
¾ tsp (4.5 g) salt
1 tbsp (15 ml) grated fresh ginger
½ tsp (2.5 ml) pepper
½ tsp (2.5 ml) ground turmeric
½ tsp (2.5 ml) paprika
355 ml water
905 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, trimmed
6 large eggs
120 ml minced fresh cilantro
455 g (36 × 23 cm) phyllo, thawed
215 g slivered almonds, toasted and chopped
28 g confectioners' sugar
1 tbsp (15 ml) ground cinnamon

1. Heat 1 tbsp (15 ml) oil in 30 cm nonstick skillet over medium heat until shimmering. Add onion and salt and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in ginger, pepper, turmeric, and paprika and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add water and chicken and bring to simmer. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until chicken registers 80 °C, 15 to 20 minutes. Transfer chicken to cutting board, let cool slightly, then shred into bite-size pieces using 2 forks; transfer to large bowl.

2. Whisk eggs together in small bowl. Bring cooking liquid to boil over high heat and cook until reduced to about 235 ml, about 10 minutes. Reduce heat to low. Whisking constantly, slowly pour eggs into broth and cook until mixture resembles loose scrambled eggs, 6 to 8 minutes; transfer to bowl with chicken. Stir in cilantro until combined. Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and let cool completely.

3. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Brush 1 phyllo sheet with oil and arrange in bottom of cooled skillet with short side against side of pan. Some phyllo will overhang edge of skillet; leave in place. Turn skillet 30°. Brush second phyllo sheet with oil and arrange in skillet, leaving any overhanging phyllo in place. Repeat turning and layering with 10 more phyllo sheets in pinwheel pattern, brushing each with oil, to cover entire circumference of skillet (you should have total of 12 layers of phyllo).

4. Combine almonds, 3 tbsp (44 ml) sugar, and 2 tsp (10 ml) cinnamon and sprinkle over phyllo in skillet. Lay 2 phyllo sheets evenly across top of almond mixture and brush top with oil. Rotate skillet 90° and lay 2 more phyllo sheets evenly across top; do not brush with oil. Spoon chicken mixture into skillet and spread into even layer.
5. Stack 5 phyllo sheets on counter and brush top with oil. Fold phyllo in half crosswise and brush top with oil. Lay phyllo stack on center of chicken mixture.
6. Fold overhanging phyllo over filling and phyllo stack, pleating phyllo every 5–7.5 cm, and press to seal. Brush top with oil and bake until phyllo is crisp and golden, 35 to 40 minutes.

7. Combine remaining 1 tbsp (12 g) sugar and remaining 1 tsp (4 g) cinnamon in small bowl. Let b'stilla cool in skillet for 15 minutes. Using rubber spatula, carefully slide b'stilla out onto cutting board. Dust top with cinnamon sugar, slice, and serve.

1. Na nepriľnavej panvici s priemerom 30 cm zohrejeme na strednom ohni 1¾ ČL (9 ml) oleja, kým sa nezačne trblietať. Pridáme cibuľu a soľ a dusíme do mäkka, asi 5 minút. Vmiešame zázvor, korenie, kurkumu a papriku a opekáme, kým nezavoňajú, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme vodu a kuracie mäso a privedieme k miernemu varu. Znížime oheň na nízky, prikryjeme a varíme, kým mäso nedosiahne 80 °C, 15–20 minút. Mäso preložíme na dosku, necháme mierne vychladnúť, potom ho 2 vidličkami natrháme na kúsky do úst; preložíme do veľkej misy.

2. V malej miske rozšľaháme vajcia. Výpek na vysokom ohni privedieme do varu a varíme, kým sa nezredukuje na asi 235 ml, asi 10 minút. Znížime oheň na nízky. Za stáleho šľahania pomaly vlievame vajcia do vývaru a varíme, kým zmes nepripomína riedku praženicu, 6–8 minút; preložíme do misy s mäsom. Vmiešame koriander. Panvicu vytrieme papierovými utierkami a necháme úplne vychladnúť.

3. Mriežku v rúre dáme do strednej polohy a rúru zohrejeme na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Jeden plát fila potrieme olejom a položíme na dno vychladnutej panvice kratšou stranou k okraju panvice. Časť fila bude presahovať cez okraj; necháme ju tak. Panvicu pootočíme o 30°. Druhý plát fila potrieme olejom a položíme do panvice, presahujúce filo opäť necháme. Otáčanie a vrstvenie zopakujeme s ďalšími 10 plátmi do tvaru veterníka, každý potrieme olejom, aby bol pokrytý celý obvod panvice (spolu by malo byť 12 vrstiev fila).

4. Zmiešame mandle, 3 PL (44 ml) cukru a 2 ČL (10 ml) škorice a posypeme filo v panvici. Na mandľovú zmes rovnomerne položíme 2 pláty fila a vrch potrieme olejom. Panvicu otočíme o 90° a navrch rovnomerne položíme ďalšie 2 pláty; olejom ich nepotierame. Lyžicou rozložíme do panvice kuraciu zmes v rovnomernej vrstve.
5. Na linke na seba poukladáme 5 plátov fila a vrch potrieme olejom. Filo priečne preložíme na polovicu a vrch potrieme olejom. Stoh položíme do stredu kuracej zmesi.
6. Presahujúce filo preložíme cez plnku a stoh fila, každých 5–7,5 cm ho zriasime a pritlačíme, aby sa spojilo. Vrch potrieme olejom a pečieme, kým filo nie je chrumkavé a zlatisté, 35–40 minút.

7. V malej miske zmiešame zvyšnú 1½ ČL (6 g) cukru a zvyšnú 1 ČL (4 g) škorice. Pastillu necháme 15 minút chladnúť v panvici. Gumenou stierkou ju opatrne vysunieme na dosku. Vrch posypeme škoricovým cukrom, nakrájame a podávame.

c.t: A ready-made pie crust can be used: blind-bake it as the maker directs and start from step 3. 475 ml half-and-half can replace the cream and milk.
Môžete použiť hotové koláčové cesto: upečte ho naslepo podľa výrobcu a začnite krokom 3. Smotanu a mlieko môžete nahradiť 475 ml zmesi mlieka a smotany.

en.t: 175 g all-purpose flour, divided, for the pie dough
1 tbsp (13 g) sugar, for the pie dough
1/2 tsp (2.5 g) kosher salt, for the pie dough
140 g unsalted butter, cut into 0.5 cm pats, for the pie dough
3 tbsp (43 ml) cold water, for the pie dough
235 ml heavy cream
235 ml whole milk
3 large eggs
1 tsp (3 g) kosher salt
Freshly ground black pepper
225 g mixed rindless soft and semi-soft cheeses (such as Gruyere, Fontina, Cheddar, Gorgonzola, Stilton, Jack, etc.), cubed or broken into small clumps
Minced chives, for garnish (optional)

1. Make the pie dough: Combine two-thirds of the flour with the sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse twice. Spread the butter slices evenly over the surface and pulse until no dry flour remains and the dough just begins to collect in clumps, about 25 short pulses. Spread the dough evenly around the bowl with a rubber spatula, sprinkle with the remaining flour, and pulse until the dough is just barely broken up, about 5 short pulses. Transfer to a large bowl.

2. Sprinkle the dough with the water, then fold and press it with a rubber spatula until it comes together into a ball. Form into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before rolling.
3. On a well-floured surface, roll the dough into a 30 cm circle.

4. Lay pie dough into a 20 cm tart pan or pie dish (at least 4 cm deep), and trim excess dough around the edge. Press dough gently into edges, then, with a docker or the tines of a fork, poke holes in even rows across the base and around the wall of dough. Freeze for at least 30 minutes and up to overnight.

5. Preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C) and set rack to center position. Line dough with parchment paper, allowing it to overhang the sides, and fill the pan with pie weights, dried beans, or dry rice. Bake the crust for 10 minutes. Remove weights and parchment paper, wrap edges of the pie dough with tin foil, and return to the oven. Bake until lightly golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove and lower oven temperature to 175 °C (fan 155 °C).
6. In a large bowl, whisk cream and milk with eggs until thoroughly incorporated. Whisk salt and pepper into custard base.

7. Scatter cheese all over bottom of pie and set on a rimmed baking sheet. Transfer to the oven, then carefully pour custard base into pie (you can slide the oven rack out slightly to help with this, but be sure to push it back gently to avoid spilling the pie filling). Bake until center is just barely set but still jiggles when touched, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool at least 15 minutes before serving. Serve warm, sprinkling minced chives on top, if desired.

c.t: 1. Make the pie dough: Combine two-thirds of the flour with the sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse twice. Spread the butter slices evenly over the surface and pulse until no dry flour remains and the dough just begins to collect in clumps, about 25 short pulses. Spread the dough evenly around the bowl with a rubber spatula, sprinkle with the remaining flour, and pulse until the dough is just barely broken up, about 5 short pulses. Transfer to a large bowl.

2. Sprinkle the dough with the water, then fold and press it with a rubber spatula until it comes together into a ball. Form into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before rolling.
3. On a well-floured surface, roll the dough into a 30 cm circle.

4. Lay pie dough into a 20 cm tart pan or pie dish (at least 4 cm deep), and trim excess dough around the edge. Press dough gently into edges, then, with a docker or the tines of a fork, poke holes in even rows across the base and around the wall of dough. Freeze for at least 30 minutes and up to overnight.

5. Preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C) and set rack to center position. Line dough with parchment paper, allowing it to overhang the sides, and fill the pan with pie weights, dried beans, or dry rice. Bake the crust for 10 minutes. Remove weights and parchment paper, wrap edges of the pie dough with tin foil, and return to the oven. Bake until lightly golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove and lower oven temperature to 175 °C (fan 155 °C).
6. In a large bowl, whisk cream and milk with eggs until thoroughly incorporated. Whisk salt and pepper into custard base.

7. Scatter cheese all over bottom of pie and set on a rimmed baking sheet. Transfer to the oven, then carefully pour custard base into pie (you can slide the oven rack out slightly to help with this, but be sure to push it back gently to avoid spilling the pie filling). Bake until center is just barely set but still jiggles when touched, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool at least 15 minutes before serving. Serve warm, sprinkling minced chives on top, if desired.

1. Pripravíme cesto: v kuchynskom robote zmiešame dve tretiny múky s cukrom a soľou a dvakrát pulzne premiešame. Plátky masla rovnomerne rozložíme po povrchu a pulzujeme, kým nezostane žiadna suchá múka a cesto sa práve nezačne zhlukovať do hrudiek, asi 25 krátkych pulzov. Cesto gumenou stierkou rovnomerne rozprestrieme po nádobe, posypeme zvyšnou múkou a pulzujeme, kým sa cesto len sotva nerozdrobí, asi 5 krátkych pulzov. Preložíme do veľkej misy.

2. Cesto pokvapkáme vodou a gumenou stierkou ho prekladáme a pritláčame, kým sa nespojí do gule. Vytvarujeme disk s priemerom 10 cm, pevne zabalíme do fólie a pred vaľkaním necháme aspoň 2 hodiny v chladničke.
3. Na dobre pomúčenej ploche cesto rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 30 cm.

4. Cesto vložíme do koláčovej formy s priemerom 20 cm (aspoň 4 cm hlbokej) a prebytočné cesto po okraji odrežeme. Cesto jemne pritlačíme k okrajom, potom valčekom na prepichovanie alebo hrotmi vidličky prepichneme dno v pravidelných radoch aj steny cesta. Necháme v mrazničke aspoň 30 minút, najviac cez noc.

5. Rúru predhrejeme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C) a mriežku dáme do strednej polohy. Cesto vyložíme papierom na pečenie tak, aby presahoval cez okraje, a formu naplníme keramickými guľôčkami, sušenou fazuľou alebo suchou ryžou. Korpus pečieme 10 minút. Záťaž aj papier vyberieme, okraje cesta obalíme alobalom a vrátime do rúry. Pečieme do svetlozlatista, 3–5 minút. Vyberieme a teplotu v rúre znížime na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C).
6. Vo veľkej mise vyšľaháme smotanu a mlieko s vajcami, kým sa dokonale nespoja. Do zmesi zašľaháme soľ a korenie.

7. Syr rozsypeme po celom dne korpusu a formu postavíme na plech s okrajom. Preložíme do rúry a opatrne vlejeme vaječnú zmes (mriežku môžeme trochu vysunúť, no potom ju jemne zasunieme späť, aby sa plnka nevyliala). Pečieme, kým stred nie je sotva stuhnutý, ale pri dotyku sa ešte chveje, asi 35 minút. Vyberieme z rúry a pred podávaním necháme aspoň 15 minút vychladnúť. Podávame teplé, podľa chuti posypané nasekanou pažítkou.
Tami's version: use lactose-free cream and milk (or lactose-free half-and-half).
Tamina verzia: použite bezlaktózovú smotanu a mlieko (alebo bezlaktózovú zmes mlieka a smotany).

cat.en: A ready-made pie crust can be used: blind-bake it as the maker directs and start from step 3.
cat.sk: Môžete použiť hotové koláčové cesto: upečte ho naslepo podľa výrobcu a začnite krokom 3.
